meta.subject: Add basic perf test and fix issue

en.summary: This commit fixes an architecturally visible counter bug in the core: the store performance event was counted when a store was requested instead of when it was actually accepted for L2 transmission, so rollbacks could overcount stores.
why_it_counts: The commit message describes a concrete wrong RTL behavior and its rollback trigger.
The patch moves the event source between hardware stages in core RTL, not in software tooling.
The added assembly test checks that back-to-back stores produce a counter delta of 4 instead of an overcount.
disqualifiers: The bug affects architectural performance counters rather than the main load/store data path.
evidence: core.sv stops sourcing the store performance event from dd_perf_store and starts sourcing it from l2i_perf_store.
dcache_data_stage.sv removes dd_perf_store <= dd_store_en, which counted the request before final send/accept.
l1_l2_interface.sv adds l2i_perf_store and drives it from storebuf_dequeue_ack, i.e. a store actually sent toward L2.
perf_counter.S intentionally creates rollback pressure and checks that the store counter increments by 4, not by extra retries.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The bug is a counter-event attribution error. A store event should be counted when the memory subsystem actually commits or transmits the store, but the old design counted it earlier, at request generation time. If a rollback or queue-full condition suppresses or retries the store, the counter increments without a corresponding architectural store completion.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Stores can be retried, squashed, or delayed between issue and actual enqueue/accept into the next memory level
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Move the store performance pulse upstream from the final accepted-send point back to the request-generation point.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: source event from pre-commit request valid instead of accepted dequeue/commit
portability_notes: Map this to the narrowest point where a store is known to be real, not merely requested.
Any store queue, store buffer, cache miss queue, or bus request arbiter can expose the same bug class.
This is reusable on other DUTs if the performance counters are architecturally visible or used as verification or profiling outputs.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the signal that pulses when a store request is formed before rollback or queue arbitration is resolved.
Drive the store performance event from that early signal instead of from the final accepted send/dequeue handshake.
Preserve the rollback path so the mismatch appears only when retries or queue-full events occur.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: store performance-event sourcing between the dcache stage and the L1/L2 interface store queue
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix removes the early dd_perf_store pulse and instead counts stores from l2i_perf_store, which is asserted when the store queue entry is actually acknowledged for L2.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Reconnect the performance-counter event source to the old request-time pulse in dcache_data_stage/core instead of the storebuf_dequeue_ack-based pulse in l1_l2_interface.sv.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The architectural store counter overcounts under rollback or store-queue pressure, even though executed stores are fewer.
evidence_for_injection: The commit message explicitly says the bug was counting requested stores, not actually sent stores.
The RTL move from dd_perf_store to l2i_perf_store matches a request-time versus commit-time event-source correction.
The new test intentionally generates back-to-back stores to expose rollback-induced overcounting.
notes: This is a valid DUT bug-fix, but it is narrower and less central than datapath-correctness bugs.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了核心中一个架构可见的计数器缺陷：store 性能事件原来在 store 被请求时就计数，而不是在它真正被接受并发送到 L2 时计数，因此 rollback 会导致 store 被多算。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确描述了具体错误的 RTL 行为以及 rollback 触发条件。
补丁在核心 RTL 的不同硬件阶段之间移动事件来源，而不是修改软件工具。
新增汇编测试检查在背靠背 store 下，计数器增量应为 4，而不是把重试也算进去。
disqualifiers: 该缺陷影响的是架构可见的性能计数器，而不是主 load/store 数据通路。
evidence: core.sv 不再从 dd_perf_store 取 store 性能事件，而改为从 l2i_perf_store 取值。
dcache_data_stage.sv 删除了 dd_perf_store <= dd_store_en，这个旧逻辑会在最终发送/接受之前就计数。
l1_l2_interface.sv 新增 l2i_perf_store，并在 storebuf_dequeue_ack 时拉高，即 store 真正发向 L2 时才计数。
perf_counter.S 故意制造 rollback 压力，并检查 store 计数器只增加 4，而不会把额外重试算进去。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该缺陷属于计数事件归属时机错误。正确做法是当 store 真正被内存子系统提交或发送时再计数，但旧设计在更早的请求生成阶段就计数了。如果 rollback 或队列满导致 store 被抑制或重试，计数器仍会增加，从而与真实完成的 store 数不一致。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: store 的架构性能事件产生时机
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: store 在发射与真正入队/被下一级内存接受之间可能被重试、撤销或延迟
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把 store 性能脉冲从最终接受发送点前移回请求生成点。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 用提交前 request valid 替代 accepted dequeue/commit 作为事件源
portability_notes: 应把该缺陷映射到能够最准确表示“store 真实发生”的那一级，而不是只表示“请求产生”的那一级。
任何 store queue、store buffer、cache miss queue 或总线请求仲裁器都可能出现同类缺陷。
只要性能计数器对架构可见，或被用作验证/性能分析输出，这个缺陷就可复用于其他 DUT。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到在 rollback 或队列仲裁完成之前，表示“已经形成 store 请求”的脉冲信号。
让 store 性能事件由这个早期信号驱动，而不是由最终 accepted send/dequeue 握手驱动。
保留 rollback 路径不变，使错误只在重试或队列满场景下显现。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: dcache 阶段与 L1/L2 接口 store queue 之间的 store 性能事件来源
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复删除了过早的 dd_perf_store 脉冲，改为在 store queue 项真正被 L2 接受时由 l2i_perf_store 计数。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把性能计数事件源重新接回 dcache_data_stage/core 中旧的 request-time 脉冲，而不是 l1_l2_interface.sv 里基于 storebuf_dequeue_ack 的脉冲。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在 rollback 或 store queue 压力下，架构 store 计数器会出现高估，实际执行的 store 数少于计数值。
evidence_for_injection: 提交信息明确说旧缺陷统计的是“请求的 store”，而不是“真正发送的 store”。
RTL 从 dd_perf_store 切换到 l2i_perf_store，正对应从 request-time 修正到 commit-time 的事件来源。
新增测试专门用背靠背 store 暴露 rollback 导致的多计数问题。
notes: 这是有效的 DUT 缺陷修复，但它比主数据通路正确性缺陷更窄一些。
